Motion.title: Motion
Motion.description: A formal proposal submitted for debate and voting

debate.description: Move a submitted motion onto the debate floor.

ActionItem.title: ActionItem
ActionItem.description: A follow-up task from a meeting decision

daysLate.description: Days between completion and due date (negative = on time) — materialised by x-openregister-calculations.

daysOpen.description: Days the action item has been open ($now − @self.created) — materialised by x-openregister-calculations.

isOverdue.description: True when not completed and dueDate has passed — materialised by x-openregister-calculations.

daysToClose.description: Days from creation to completion (@self.created → completedAt). Materialised by x-openregister-calculations.
